tank_description: An agile close-range defender built around layered protection and aggressive engagements. It combines strong survivability with reliable firepower and a powerful close-quarters toolkit, rewarding players who know when to push and when to preserve their protection.

strengths.title: Shields
strengths.description: The M60A3E2 is unique in that it has stronger shields than other vehicles which effectively have the health of 300hp. The shields (located on the front and sides of both the hull and turret) is useful against all ammunitions ,besides high explosives which have modifiers versus shields.

strengths.title: Damage Per Minute
strengths.description: Despite having one of the lowest base damages for its class, the M60A3 makes up for it by having an impressive rate of fire. Use this to your advantage as most do not expect it.

strengths.title: Titan Shell
strengths.description: Strengthens your shields, blocking all damage to them for the duration of the ability at the cost of mobility. (Shields are require for it to work!)

strengths.title: Spike
strengths.description: Thanks to the M60A3E2’s toolkit enemies who look to rush to the M60 are in for a nasty surprise. The M60A3 is capable of sacrificing shields to deliver a very heavy and quite often lethal blow to enemies within range that dazes and immobilises.

strengths.title: Hit-points
strengths.description: The M60A3E2 can be built to be an HP whale having around 6000 HP. This is more than the majority of other tanks in the game.

weaknesses.title: Mobility
weaknesses.description: Compared to other defenders, the M60A3E2's mobility is slow and sluggish. You can be easily flanked and circled by most tanks (including other defenders). Keeping your head on a swivel is a must!

weaknesses.title: Base Damage
weaknesses.description: The M60A3E2's current base damage is the lowest for the defender class (excluding the BAT-4M). Sitting with 430 damage, to maximize DPM you should be aiming for modules and critical hits.

weaknesses.title: Range
weaknesses.description: Even with the M60A3E2's good gun ballistics, it is recommended to avoid long range combat as beyond 50m damage falloff starts and past 100m the damage is minimal.

weaknesses.title: Critical Hit boxes
weaknesses.description: The modules of this vehicle are large and easy to hit, especially the engine module hitbox. It also has a centrally places ammorack, so good marksman can easily hit this and do massive damage after getting past the shields.

weaknesses.title: High Explosives
weaknesses.description: Due to the nature of how HE/HESH currently work (modifiers versus shields), they are able to easily destroy shields and add-on armor. Keep this in mind when playing the M60A3E2.

tank_summary: The M60A3E2 is an agile defender that excels at close-range engagements, relying heavily on sacrificial shielding and ERA to protect the vehicle from incoming fire. These systems cover much of its otherwise unimpressive armour, allowing the M60A3E2 to remain in the fight while its protection lasts. Combined with a generous health pool and relatively small critical zones, the M60A3E2 can be a difficult defender to remove from the fight whilst it's shielding lasts.

A fast-firing APHE cannon with favourable handling allows the M60A3E2 to maintain a steady pressure whilst aiming to close the distance where it thrives. Players of the M60A3E2 should seek to close the gap and force enemies into engagements where its toolkit allows it to deal impressive bursts of damage using its blast projectors to deal significant AOE.

However, players should be cautious. Committing to a brawl should always be a calculated decision as once its shielding has been depleted the M60A3E2 becomes significantly more vulnerable, with most incoming shots capable of penetrating its average armour. Players must therefore know when to preserve their protection and when to deliberately expend it, turning the vehicle into a dangerous close-quarters defender that rewards aggressive but carefully timed engagements.
